description.en: Records the outcome of a single match action (shot, tackle, clash, etc.) into the match log — whether it succeeded, the attack/defense power involved, and whether it was a foul or a miss.
Whether the action succeeded (e.g. the attacker won the clash).
Optional attack power value involved in the action; only read together with defensePower when at least 3 arguments are given.
Optional defense power value involved in the action; only read when at least 3 arguments are given.
Optional flag marking the action as a foul; only read when at least 4 arguments are given.
Optional flag marking the action as a miss; only read when at least 5 arguments are given.
Always null — the native implementation never pushes a value onto the stack on success; null is also returned if no success argument was given.
